apps.summary: Fast, native code editor: an early fork of Zed with privacy-friendly defaults.
highlights: Tracks upstream Zed closely; Ferrum changes are branding, packaging and defaults
Telemetry, crash reporting and auto-update are off by default
roadmap: Shared Ferrum theme and toolbox integration

apps.summary: Local-first, Postman-style API client. No backend, no account, no webview.
highlights: Send any HTTP method with raw, form, multipart and binary bodies
Basic, Bearer and API key auth with {{variable}} environments
Collections, history, Postman v2.1 and cURL import, code generation
roadmap: Hands-on QA of the GPUI interface

apps.summary: Local-first Git client with a commit graph and per-project SSH profiles.
highlights: Virtualized commit graph with branches, merges and ref badges
Stage, unstage and discard files, hunks and lines
Profiles bind a commit identity and SSH key to each repository
roadmap: Hands-on QA of the GPUI interface

apps.summary: Local-first, DataGrip-class database IDE. PostgreSQL today.
highlights: PostgreSQL profiles with TLS, environment tags and read-only sessions
Streaming query execution with cancel and a virtualized result grid
Passwords stay in the OS keychain
roadmap: Row editing, query history and CSV/JSON export

apps.summary: GPU terminal for humans and AI agents, with persistent server-side sessions.
highlights: Sessions, windows and split panes live in a server and survive closing the window
fterm CLI and tmux-style attach over SSH
Agent status, waits and notifications for Claude Code and Codex
roadmap: Visual QA of the GPUI window
Windows support (the server uses Unix sockets today)

apps.summary: Installs, updates, rolls back and launches every Ferrum app.
highlights: Every version comes from GitHub Releases, with checksums verified
Stable and Beta update channels per app
Keeps several versions so you can switch back in one click
roadmap: Self-update that restarts into the new version
